description: Robbie Robertson, Felicia Hardy and the Black Cat move to the center as Spider-Man faces Tombstone, Kraven, Morbius and the Green Goblin while Peter's personal life grows more fragile.

s04e01.description: Tombstone and Richard Fisk frame Robbie Robertson, leaving Spider-Man to expose the plot before Robbie is swallowed by the prison system.

s04e02.description: Doctor Octopus blackmails Felicia's mother with the secret of Felicia's father, drawing Spider-Man into the Hardy family's hidden past.

s04e03.description: The Kingpin uses a super-soldier formula to transform Felicia into Black Cat and forces her to serve his criminal plans.

s04e04.description: Kraven asks Spider-Man for help when the woman he loves is transformed into a feral creature by the same science that changed him.

s04e05.description: Black Cat and Spider-Man's partnership becomes personal while Alistair Smythe and the Kingpin exploit divided loyalties around them.

s04e06.description: Morbius awakens from captivity and Black Cat is pulled toward helping him, complicating her partnership with Spider-Man.

s04e07.description: Blade discovers that the powerful vampire queen Miriam is tied to his own past, bringing Spider-Man and Black Cat into the hunt.

s04e08.description: Harry Osborn learns Peter's secret and becomes the Green Goblin, turning grief and resentment into a direct threat to Peter and Mary Jane.

s04e09.description: Mary Jane's acting debut is disrupted by apparent supernatural events connected to Mysterio and a secret beneath the theater.

s04e10.description: A society of lizard creatures beneath New York kidnaps Curt Connors and wants the Lizard to become their ruler.

s04e11.description: A young criminal given a powerful suit by the Kingpin tries to escape his patron, forcing Spider-Man to help the Prowler reclaim his life.
